question: On 21st January 2022, Tripura, Manipur and Meghalaya celebrated their ______ Foundation Day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**50th**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**

 
• These three northeastern states achieved statehood on this day in **1972 under the North Eastern Region (Reorganisation) Act, 1971**.
 
• Prior to statehood, Tripura and Manipur were princely states merged with India in **1949.**
 
• Meghalaya was part of Assam until it became an autonomous state **in 1969.**
 
• The **50th **anniversary marked a significant milestone, commemorating the journey of these states towards self-governance and development.
 
• The occasion was celebrated with various cultural programs, parades, and government functions, highlighting the rich cultural heritage and progress of these states.
